_comment: Launcher game profile (the PLA-SPECIFIC part; the launcher itself is generic). It only holds identifiers, hashes and build ids of the official executable (the same as data/target.json, which is already versioned), repo paths and options. Never keys, binaries or generated C.

baked_patches.note: Unlocked FPS with dynamic delta (43 changes; grows .text 0x32A5690 -> 0x32A5900 for the code cave)

roots.sources: eh_frame, vtables, relocs, jump tables, landing pads (tools/analysis/code_targets.py)

emitter.note: PROGRESS-PERF flags (recipe of the dist xc DLLs; subsdk0/1 also get FPXOOL here). The exporter ignores options it does not know: launcher.py checks them in aot_manifest.json after the export (verify_emitter).

dist._exe_args_note: PLA.exe (plahost, docs/port/HOST.md) needs no arguments or environment: mods\ next to the exe, nvnvk and nnshim always loaded. Shortcuts and the installer's Play start PLA.exe as is.
dist._ini_values_note: The PLA.ini keys plahost reads (fullscreen, mods, nvnvk_fps_cap, hang_report; also name, memory_mib, window_width/height). The in-game menu (nvnvk) writes fullscreen and nvnvk_fps_cap; a re-assembly keeps those (launcher.py INI_MENU_KEYS).
dist._mods_local_note: generated from the user's main.elf and compiled at install time with the portable toolchain (tools/islands/build_islands.py): they contain lifted game code, so they are never shipped prebuilt.
dist._mods_recomp_note: engine_options and render_res are the option mods the in-game menu (nvnvk) drives; shipped prebuilt with their default (neutral) config.

mods_platform._extra_note: official SDL2 (zlib); looked up in build/port/<id>, the fork and the NuGet cache (ultz.native.sdl)
mods_platform.note: native fs/hid/saves; romfs and saves inside the game folder

mods_platform._mod_json_note: template = build/port/nvnvk/mod.template.json (hooks generated at release time by gen_tables.py); the launcher fills the config
